model_time_convention: match ProcessedDataLoader: round(Hours_elapsed - 477700.0) to nominal integer-hour slots before covariance fitting and scoring
anchor_rule: all regular-grid centers for which all four frozen physical endpoints snap inside the fixed analysis grid
anchor_identity: regular latitude index and regular longitude index
snapping_rule: nearest uniform regular-grid axis using numpy.rint; reject targets farther than one-half grid step; covariance uses actual Source_Latitude and Source_Longitude at snapped cells
mean_rule: audit max absolute W X first; use monthly-centered raw Y if below tolerance, otherwise one common daywise OLS mean with intercept, centered source latitude, and seven nominal time indicators
primary_diagnostic: mean constant-free bivariate Gaussian contrast score evaluated with each sample-specific 2x2 covariance

models.gc: joint generalized Cauchy with alpha=0.75 and beta=1
models.matern05: joint Matern with nu=0.5, equivalently exp(-joint scaled distance)
models.separable: independently fitted advected-separable exponential spatial-times-temporal covariance

interpretation_boundary: design-held-out but same-day fitted targeted in-sample covariance adequacy comparison among three pre-specified equal-dimensional covariance specifications; not predictive holdout and not a ranking of all members of the named covariance families
